preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000) representing the number of favourite integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains t space-separated integers x_i (1 ≤ x_i ≤ 10^18), each representing a favourite integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(['YES' if is_possible(x) else 'NO' for x in map(int, stdin.split()[1:])]) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each x_i in the input, output 'YES' if there exists a tower configuration with exactly x_i visible pips, otherwise output 'NO'. The output is a newline-separated list of answers.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' == answer or 'NO' == answer for answer in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO', with no additional formatting or whitespace.
